$comment: F1 resource limits. Contract f1-extensions/1. Every limit ships limit-1, limit and limit+1 vectors with identical counting and precedence in both runtimes.
precedence: Total input-size checks precede tokenization; afterwards document order decides the first violation. Limits are checked before allocation: traversal is bounded with explicit stacks, and no bare stack overflow or allocation failure is an accepted diagnostic.

xml-input-bytes.counts: Raw XML input bytes as received, before decoding.

xml-decoded-bytes.counts: Decoded character data re-encoded as UTF-8, checked independently from the raw size.

xml-depth.counts: Nesting depth with the root element counting as 1. Applies to XML input, JSON input and native-model traversal alike.

xml-elements.counts: Total elements (XML), nodes (JSON) or visited elements (native traversal), including nested generic content.

xml-attributes-per-element.counts: Attributes of one element including namespace declarations; on JSON input, $attrs entries of one node.

xml-attr-name-utf16.counts: One attribute name; on JSON input, every map key and $name part. Counted in Python as len(s.encode('utf-16-le', 'surrogatepass')) // 2 (lone surrogates count as one unit).

xml-attr-value-utf16.counts: One attribute value; on JSON input, every string value including $body. Counted in Python as len(s.encode('utf-16-le', 'surrogatepass')) // 2 (lone surrogates count as one unit).

json-object-bytes.counts: Object entry size: the UTF-8 byte length of the profile-c14n/2 (JCS) bytes of the projected JSON, excluding runtime links.

warning-cap.counts: Maximum collected warnings per conversion; the first omitted warning yields exactly one moddle-warning-truncated diagnostic.
